title: Late Fee Amount for a PracticePay Patient Financing Due Date
content:
**Due date charged.** The due date the late fee is for is the plan's oldest unpaid due date as the plan shows it.

**Unpaid part.** The unpaid part of that monthly payment is the smaller of the plan's monthly payment amount and its amount past due less the disputed amounts of the plan's billing disputes that are still open, never below zero.

**The fee.** The late fee for that due date is the plan's standard late fee (the per-plan late fee in the PracticePay Patient Financing fee schedule), never more than the unpaid part, rounded half up to the nearest cent. Stated generally: the fee level, multiplied by every share that the fee schedule sets, all shares applying together to that one fee level, is then capped at the unpaid part and rounded half up to the nearest cent once, at the end.

A late fee that works out to 0.00 is not owed, and nothing is booked for it.

## Worked figures (hypothetical plan whose late fee is taken as 30.00 USD for illustration)

| Monthly payment | Amount past due | Open disputed amount | Unpaid part | Late fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 100.00 | 100.00 | 0.00 | 100.00 | 30.00 |
| 100.00 | 250.00 | 0.00 | 100.00 (the monthly payment is smaller) | 30.00 |
| 100.00 | 15.00 | 0.00 | 15.00 | 15.00 |
| 100.00 | 100.00 | 100.00 | 0.00 | 0.00, not owed |
| 100.00 | 70.00 | 80.00 | 0.00 (never below zero) | 0.00, not owed |
